name: Candy Coated BITEZ Gummies 500mg Baggiez | Delta-9 | Rainbow
description: Rainbow tastes like somebody shook the whole candy aisle into one bag. A kaleidoscope of fruity candy notes shifts from sweet to tart as you chew, while tiny, colorful crunchy candies blanket the outside for a crackly first bite. Break through the coating and two soft, chewy gummy layers packing 50mg of hemp-derived Delta-9 THC in each gummy take over, making every mouthful a different mix of crunch, fruit, and candy sweetness.
